about.description: ABCD is a licensed HIP-3 perpetual venue on Hyperliquid operated by trade[XYZ] (the Hyperunit team), featuring the first officially S&P-licensed equity-index perpetual on a decentralized exchange. Announced on March 18, 2026, the deployment lets eligible non-US investors gain leveraged 24/7 exposure to the S&P 500® via cash-settled perpetual contracts margined in USDC. Markets appear under the abcd namespace on Hyperliquid and use real-time data feeds from S&P Dow Jones Indices.
about.registryInfo: ABCD is a HIP-3 deployment operated by trade[XYZ] (Hyperunit team) and was the first decentralized exchange to receive an official S&P Dow Jones Indices license to offer S&P 500® perpetual contracts (announced March 18, 2026). Markets appear under the abcd namespace on Hyperliquid and use real-time data sourced from S&P Dow Jones Indices.

fees.revenueNotes: ABCD is a HIP-3 namespace operated by trade[XYZ] on Hyperliquid (first decentralized S&P 500 perp). Fees follow HIP-3 framework: standard taker ~7-9 bps, Growth Mode taker ~0.45-0.9 bps. 50% of fees go to the trade[XYZ] deployer, 50% to Hyperliquid protocol. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals
